instruction: Turn off the 'one instance when started from file' option in VLC. I want to be able to open multiple VLC windows when clicking on different video files.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

Uses existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric function and get_vlc_config getter. The evaluator reads vlcrc config file and checks if one-instance-when-started-from-file is set to 0.
